trailhead.label: The Celat town hall, San Tomaso Agordino, the board’s start

cautions: A fairly steep climb out of Celat at the start: take it slowly with an older dog.
The descent back into the village can be slippery: go carefully and keep your dog close.
The start is on the village road outside the town hall: keep your dog on a short lead there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Dolomites in Miniature, San Tomaso Agord: Le Dolomiti in miniatura di San Tomaso Agordino
textIt.The Celat town hall, San Tomaso Agordino: Il municipio di Celat, San Tomaso Agordino, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.A fairly steep climb out of Celat at the: Una salita abbastanza ripida all’uscita da Celat: vai piano con un cane anziano.
textIt.The descent back into the village can be: La discesa di rientro in paese può essere scivolosa: procedi con attenzione e tieni il cane vicino.
textIt.The start is on the village road outside: La partenza è sulla strada del paese davanti al municipio: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
